name: Globe Trade Centre S.A.
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from Globe Trade Centre S.A. reviewed condensed consolidated interim income statement, six months ended 30 June 2026, unit EUR million stored in absolute euro. Revenue 106.3 is the printed rental revenue of 80.3 plus service charge revenue of 26.0, which the issuer reports together as revenues from rental activity of 106.3; cost of sales 33.6 is the printed service charge costs, and 106.3 less 33.6 equals the printed gross margin from operations of 72.7. Operating expenses 12.0 is selling expenses 0.6 plus administration expenses 11.4. Operating profit 60.7 is computed as that gross margin less those two expense lines, before the printed loss from revaluation of investment properties of 22.5, a fair value movement the ten row schema does not hold; the issuer prints a net operating result of 37.4 after the revaluation, other income 1.0, other expenses 2.1 and a 0.3 profit on revaluation of financial assets. Net finance costs 45.1 is financial cost 48.2 less financial income 3.1; the printed result before tax of (8.2) also carries a 0.5 foreign exchange loss. Income tax 9.9 and the printed result for the period of (18.1) tie: (8.2) less 9.9 equals (18.1). EPS is the printed basic and diluted loss per share of 0.03 euro.
